parts:
Hi ,

In the methylkit if we need to do per base methylation analysis we use the unite() function but it is recommended not to use the unite function with CHG/CHH methylation context. regards

parts: if you mean that you don't want to analyze CHG and CHH context in the same analysis, you have to read them in separately and do a separate analysis for each of the contexts. That means you need to separate your input files which should be easy to do with awk or perl.
